    Join the Shahid Lab

    We welcome curious researchers interested in interspecies RNA interference, epigenetics, plant–biotic interactions, and biology of complex interacting genome. Our work combines experimental and computational approaches to understand host-parasitic plant interactions and how these discoveries could contribute to more resilient crops. Whether you are looking for a PhD project, developing a fellowship, interested in visiting the lab or exploring a collaboration, we’d be happy to hear from you.

    We welcome enquiries from prospective students interested in developing a project with us, as well as applications to advertised funded studentships. Feel free to contact Dr. Shahid to discuss potential projects.

    Postdoctoral Fellowship Opportunities

    Postdoctoral researchers interested in joining the Shahid Lab are encouraged to contact Dr. Shahid to discuss independent fellowship funding opportunities. If there is a strong scientific fit, we can work with prospective fellows to develop the research question, identify appropriate schemes and connect the project with relevant expertise across Sheffield.

    Research Environment

    The Shahid Lab is based in the School of Biosciences at the University of Sheffield. We are part of the Plants, Photosynthesis and Soil Cluster (PPS) and the Sheffield Institute for Nucleic Acids, connecting our research with a broad community working across plant biology, ecology, molecular biology, genomics and nucleic-acid science.

    The School of Biosciences is one of the largest single-site communities of bioscientists in the UK, including a substantial concentration of expertise in plant science. This creates a highly collaborative environment for interdisciplinary research, with opportunities to access complementary expertise, develop new collaborations and work across experimental and computational approaches. The strength of this research environment was recognised in REF2021, with School of Biosciences ranking 4th in UK.

    Researchers in the lab have access to an extensive range of outstanding facilities across Sheffield, including:

    • David Read Controlled Environment Facility
    • The Arthur Willis Environment Centre
    • NERC Environmental Omics Facility
    • Biological Mass Spectrometry Facility (biOMICS)
    • The Wolfson Centre for Disease Phenomics
    • Wolfson Light Microscopy Facility

    Life in Sheffield

    Sheffield combines a major research university with a relatively compact, affordable city surrounded by the Peak District. The School of Biosciences is close to the city centre, while green space and the national park are easily accessible.
